assertions.expected: Trigger the family road-trip workflow from a normal travel request without development context.
assertions.observed: The fresh task identified the family road-trip workflow and separated planning from booking.

assertions.expected: Expose missing dates, entry point, child age, and onward-travel assumptions.
assertions.observed: The plan declared a summer west-entrance scenario and requested the missing details before date-specific verification.

assertions.expected: Compare materially different route or lodging shapes before selecting one.
assertions.observed: The plan explained why three nights outside the west entrance would burden the only driver, but did not provide a complete route-direction or lodging-shape comparison.

assertions.expected: Cross-check the route with independent map roles.
assertions.observed: Official segment times were cited, but no primary-plus-independent map verification was delivered.

assertions.expected: Count every planned vehicle movement in each daily driving total.
assertions.observed: The third-day total did not clearly include the evening out-and-back drive between the lodging area and the thermal-basin stop.

assertions.expected: Use official authorities for park, road, weather, fee, reservation, lodging, and dining rules.
assertions.observed: National Park Service and the authorized lodging concessioner controlled the relevant operational claims.

assertions.expected: Use two independent review or discovery sources and classify negative patterns for important meals.
assertions.observed: Only official restaurant pages were used; no independent review patterns or quality limitations were delivered.

assertions.expected: Expose retrieval time, source role, access result, fallback, and unresolved facts.
assertions.observed: Links were cited, but the output did not label full, partial, blocked, or manual-only access and did not provide a per-source fallback table.

assertions.expected: Provide executable parking cards for selected lodging and congested attractions.
assertions.observed: Attraction congestion exits were useful, but hotel entrance, unloading, lobby path, fee or height, unknowns, and confirmation fallback were incomplete.

assertions.expected: Keep recommendations separate from confirmed bookings and guarantees.
assertions.observed: The output made no booking and kept date-specific availability unresolved.

sources.observed: Official segment times and driving caveats were used, but the delivered plan did not add an independent map role.
Vehicle entry and nonresident fee rules were current and correctly conditioned on age and residency assumptions.
The direct operator supported reservation-window and cancellation-policy claims.
The direct restaurant page supported hours and service style, but no independent quality evidence was added.
Seasonal weather limits and recheck timing were handled appropriately because exact dates were absent.

limitations: The raw localized answer is not stored in the public repository; this record preserves only anonymized behavior assertions.
Exact travel dates, entry and exit logistics, child age, and booked lodging were not supplied.
The run proves automatic workflow routing and several official-source behaviors, but it failed the complete runtime gate.
The identified failures were converted into deterministic regression cases before the Skill was revised.
